question: What primary document acts as the master blueprint for guiding what student midwives learn during their training?
explanation: A curriculum outlines the overall plan, subjects, and learning experiences required for a programme of study. [learn more](BMP312_U3_T3#BMP312_U3_T3_h1)

question: Why must midwifery training programs in Nigeria match national health goals, such as lowering maternal mortality?

options.A: To ensure student midwives address the specific health needs of local communities
options.B: To eliminate the need for clinical hospital postings
options.C: To focus exclusively on international nursing standards
options.D: To make the training programme shorter and less expensive

explanation: Aligning education with local health realities ensures graduates possess the exact skills required to save lives in their practice environments. [learn more](BMP312_U3_T3#BMP312_U3_T3_h1)

question: What is the main focus of competency-based midwifery education?

options.A: Passing written examinations without practical tests
options.C: Memorising the history of global nursing leaders
options.D: Completing a fixed number of hours sitting in lectures

explanation: Competency-based education prioritises the actual performance and mastery of practical tasks over time spent in a classroom. [learn more](BMP312_U3_T3#BMP312_U3_T3_h2)

question: A student midwife is observed performing newborn resuscitation on a mannequin to prove she can handle an emergency before going to the labour ward. What type of assessment is this?
explanation: Evaluating a student to verify mastery of a required skill before granting clinical clearance functions as a summative check. [learn more](BMP312_U3_T3#BMP312_U3_T3_h2)

question: Which of these is an example of an action word that can be easily measured in a clinical learning objective?
explanation: Demonstrate is an observable action that an examiner can watch and grade, unlike abstract words like understand or appreciate. [learn more](BMP312_U3_T3#BMP312_U3_T3_h3)

question: Why do midwifery educators avoid using the word 'understand' when writing learning objectives?

options.A: It prevents students from asking questions in class
options.B: It is grammatically incorrect in professional writing
options.C: It is only used for advanced postgraduate research courses
options.D: It is too vague and difficult to measure objectively

explanation: Because internal understanding cannot be directly seen, objectives require external, observable actions to prove mastery. [learn more](BMP312_U3_T3#BMP312_U3_T3_h3)

question: What is the main purpose of a lesson plan in midwifery education?

options.A: To replace the official school curriculum entirely
options.B: To record the disciplinary history of student midwives
options.C: To serve as a structured roadmap for a single teaching session
options.D: To track the monthly salary of the teaching staff

explanation: A lesson plan guides the instructor step-by-step through a specific class period to ensure all learning goals are met. [learn more](BMP312_U3_T3#BMP312_U3_T3_h4)

question: What is the main function of the introduction phase in a well-structured lesson plan?

options.A: To capture student attention and connect new material to prior knowledge
options.B: To clean up the clinical demonstration laboratory
options.C: To administer the final grade for the entire semester
options.D: To dismiss the students early from class

explanation: An effective introduction hooks the learners and prepares their minds by bridging what they already know with what they are about to learn. [learn more](BMP312_U3_T3#BMP312_U3_T3_h4)

question: Which teaching method works best for training student midwives to repair an episiotomy before working on real patients?

options.A: A large hall lecture on health history

explanation: Hands-on demonstration and simulation allow students to practice psychomotor skills safely before performing them on mothers. [learn more](BMP312_U3_T3#BMP312_U3_T3_h5)

question: A lecturer wants students to practice critical thinking by discussing a real patient scenario involving severe pre-eclampsia. Which teaching strategy should they choose?
explanation: Case studies present realistic clinical problems that challenge students to apply diagnostic reasoning and decision-making skills. [learn more](BMP312_U3_T3#BMP312_U3_T3_h5)

question: What is the main purpose of an Objective Structured Clinical Examination (OSCE) in midwifery training?

options.A: To assess administrative leadership skills in hospital management
options.B: To grade the cleanliness of the student uniform
options.C: To evaluate practical clinical competence through timed stations
options.D: To test long-term memory using long essay questions

explanation: An OSCE uses structured stations where students perform specific clinical tasks while examiners score them against objective checklists. [learn more](BMP312_U3_T3#BMP312_U3_T3_h6)

question: What should a midwifery school do when multiple students consistently fail a specific clinical skill assessment?

options.A: Blame the external regulatory body for the examination questions
options.B: Review and revise the curriculum, lesson plans, and teaching methods
options.C: Remove all practical assessments from the programme permanently
options.D: Assume the students are simply lazy and increase the passing mark

explanation: Widespread failure often signals a gap in how the material is taught or structured, requiring educators to evaluate and improve their own instruction. [learn more](BMP312_U3_T3#BMP312_U3_T3_h6)
